description: Implementation of an in-memory queue consumer for the Thingsboard platform, handling subscription, polling, and partition management.

classes.name: InMemoryTbQueueConsumer
classes.description: A generic in-memory queue consumer implementation for handling message consumption, subscription, and partition management within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: InMemoryTbQueueConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage and topic, setting initial stopped state.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic associated with this consumer.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a default partition for the topic.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the storage for subscribed partitions, with sleep on empty.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is stopped.

methods.name: getFullTopicNames
methods.description: Returns list of full topic names for current partitions.
